name: Finding OR Sum
description: ALTER EGO - Yuta Imai vs Qlarabelle This is an interactive problem. There are two hidden non-negative integers $$$x$$$ and $$$y$$$ ($$$0 \leq x, y \lt 2^{30}$$$). You can ask no more than $$$2$$$ queries of the following form. Pick a non-negative integer $$$n$$$ ($$$0 \leq n \lt 2^{30}$$$). The judge will respond with the value of $$$(n \mathbin{|} x) + (n \mathbin{|} y)$$$, where $$$|$$$ denotes the bitwise OR operation . After this, the judge will give you another non-negative integer $$$m$$$ ($$$0 \leq m \lt 2^{30}$$$). You must answer the correct value of $$$(m \mathbin{|} x) + (m \mathbin{|} y)$$$.
input_specification: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$). The description of the test cases follows.
approach_summary: Design an adaptive query strategy maintaining uncertainty bounds. Halve candidate space or probe tree centroids using at most the allowed query budget.
